gitCommit.subject: Ops: verify-production expects Riyade's three pages and the 42-URL sitemap
gitCommit.body:
Ops: verify-production expects Riyade's three pages and the 42-URL sitemap

The release of 2026-10-20 (tsx-public-site 5aa8322, the owner's approval) adds /products/riyade, /fr/products/riyade
and /ar/products/riyade. Two checks are added; every other check is kept as it was.
- Sitemap: exactly 42 URLs (14 indexable pages in 3 languages), the same set as the build's own sitemap.xml, the three
  Riyade addresses among them. The existing check (every URL on the origin, nothing in-app or protected) stays.
- Riyade in each language: 200, <html lang dir> (ar: rtl), its own canonical, "Riyade" as the one h1, and no
  SoftwareApplication, offer or price in its structured data.
Checked locally by routing https://tsxmr.com to a local server: the release build passes both; production's current
build (5f666ea) fails both (39 URLs, three 404s), where the older sitemap check alone passes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01QVaHmhvXSCrmndjXnKST77
